{{Quote|Ever since the Vaklin's recolonization by Trivak Ninegun, the planet has been a fertile recruiting ground for the Jedi.|Namada mentions Ninegun in her report|<ref name="TTF2">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]]</ref>}}
'''Trivak Ninegun''' was an individual who led the recolonization of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]],<ref name="TTF2" /> located in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> After Ninegun's recolonization, the planet produced large numbers of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] who were recruited into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], with the planet's general population becoming largely pro-Jedi. [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Oniye Namada]] mentioned Ninegun in a report she wrote in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] detailing the [[Vaklin insurgency]], titled [[I-1807-VAK]].<ref name="TTF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trivak Ninegun was first mentioned in the [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries [[Star Wars: Purge – The Tyrant's Fist|''Star Wars: Purge: The Tyrant's Fist'']]. The issue was written [[Alexander Freed]] and and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="TTF2" /> on [[January 2]], [[2013]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54468/star_wars_purge_-_the_tyrants_fist_2012_2|text=Star Wars: Purge - The Tyrant's Fist (2012) #2}}</ref>
